notes.title: Q1 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

In this update we focused on adding a new item to manage light, as well as balancing the random room generation and the spawning of items to improve the overall experience. We also fixed some minor aesthetic issues with furniture placement.

For the next update our main focus will be adding difficulty levels, as well as adding some variety to the gameplay loop.

Best regards!

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added candle item as a new light source.
[*] Changed wall chandeliers so that players can choose when and where to use candles.
[*] Added puzzle door variants.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Balanced spawning of items.
[*] Balanced appearance of puzzle doors.
[*] Balanced room type and aesthetics occurrence throughout the game run.
[*] Fixed position of some slightly misplaced furniture.
[/list]

notes.title: Next steps
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you are having a great holiday season!

In the next quarter we will be working on adding more depth to the game. We are adding a new lighting item to give players another tool in their struggle against the darkness, and we will work on puzzles by reworking the puzzle door system so that players can make the most of the items they hold and adding additional puzzles of varying difficulties.

Happy 2025!
RVG
